_comment: Station configuration. Values are raw strings/numbers; safety-critical caps live in admin_caps.json under data_root, NOT here.
_data_root: Where runs + specimen registry live. Empty = <home>/sldea-runs. NEVER a OneDrive-synced path (runstore refuses).
_sg_resource: BK4055B VISA resource. Empty = USB autodetect. LAN example: TCPIP0::192.168.71.230::INSTR (env SCPI_SG_LAN also honored).
_channels: Trek V_Out -> scope CH2 (1 V = 1 kV), I_Out -> CH3 (1 V = 200 uA) -- lab default, gui.py:2488 lineage.
_trek_inverts: true when the Trek is set to invert: negates the commanded control voltage AND both monitor readings.
_paschen_block_pa: HV is inhibited while attested chamber pressure is inside this band [Pa]. PLACEHOLDER pending lab review -- covers the Paschen minimum region for mm-cm gaps with margin. Override requires typed confirmation and is logged.
